abstract_evidence_excerpt: This study investigated the effect of different micro-aeration dosages for blackwater AD. Sequencing batch reactors were operated at ambient room temperature (22 ± 1°C) with micro-aeration (0, 5, 10, 50, and 150 mg O2 g-1 CODfeed per cycle) and gradually reduced hydraulic retention times from 5 d to 2 d.
